Implemented .create-btn style class with proper contrast, hover states, and disabled state styling

signup_defects_fixed.resolution: Captured phone in AuthController register and persisted to User model

signup_defects_fixed.resolution: Explicit field-level and top-level error binding with server message rendering

staged_onboarding_steps.name: Owner Account Establishment
staged_onboarding_steps.description: Owner user and tenant business account provisioned with default primary branch placeholder and onboarding_status set to incomplete

staged_onboarding_steps.name: Business Identity
staged_onboarding_steps.description: Establish legal trading entity details, industry business type, contact channels, and physical address

staged_onboarding_steps.name: Primary Branch Configuration
staged_onboarding_steps.description: Configure the flagship / main operational branch code, location, and contact phone

staged_onboarding_steps.name: Business Operational Defaults
staged_onboarding_steps.description: Select currency, timezone, tax configuration, and invoice numbering prefix

staged_onboarding_steps.name: Review & Ready
staged_onboarding_steps.description: Verify configuration summary, initialize financial cash drawer and branch defaults, and complete onboarding
staged_onboarding_steps.persisted_state: onboarding_status = completed, onboarding_completed_at set to timestamp

resumption_rules.behavior_on_relogin: If onboarding_status is incomplete, redirect owner to /onboarding/status to resume at persisted onboarding_step
resumption_rules.duplicate_business_prevention: Resume workflow operates on existing business_id; zero duplicate business records created
resumption_rules.existing_tenants_policy: Pre-existing tenants with null onboarding_status receive PROFILE_INCOMPLETE without data fabrication
